summary: This is a two-channel ESP32-S3 function generator: each channel has an AD9833 DDS waveform source, an optional ~0.2x attenuator, an offset-removal and gain stage, an AD5452 multiplying DAC for digital amplitude control, and a summing stage that adds a DC offset from an MCP4822 DAC. Each channel's output is switched to a terminal through a relay and a 49.9 Ω series resistor, and the instrument is controlled from an ILI9341 touch display and a rotary encoder, running from a 12 V barrel jack that is converted to ±12 V, +5 V and +3.3 V.

blocks.name: power-input
blocks.purpose: 12 V barrel-jack input with an on/off switch that creates the switched +12C rail.

blocks.name: bipolar-supply
blocks.purpose: A TMR 6-1222 DC-DC converter makes the ±12 V analog rails for all the op-amps, with bulk and HF decoupling on both outputs.

blocks.name: logic-supply
blocks.purpose: An LM7805 makes +5 V from +12C, then an AP2112K-3.3 LDO makes the +3.3 V logic and DAC rail.

blocks.name: mcu
blocks.purpose: The ESP32-S3 DevKitC runs the UI and drives a shared SPI bus (GPIO11/GPIO12) to the DDS chips, multiplying DACs and offset DAC, using a separate select line for each.

blocks.name: user-interface
blocks.purpose: ILI9341 TFT with touch controller on its own SPI pins, plus a rotary encoder with push switch, for user control.

blocks.name: dds-sources
blocks.purpose: Two AD9833 waveform generators, each routed through a TS5A23157 analog switch either directly or via a 39.2k/10k attenuator into its channel.

blocks.name: center-bias
blocks.purpose: A filtered 0.423 V reference made from +3.3 V and buffered by U15A, used to remove the DC level of the DDS signal in both channels.

blocks.name: ch1-preamp
blocks.purpose: U4A (gain ≈5, subtracting about 4×CENTER_BIAS) and U4B (gain 4) amplify the CH1 DDS signal by ≈20 to drive the AD5452 reference input.

blocks.name: ch2-preamp
blocks.purpose: Same gain chain as CH1 for channel 2, using U11 with R18/R19 and R21/R22.

blocks.name: ch1-amplitude-and-offset
blocks.purpose: AD5452 U8 with U5A as I-to-V converter scales the waveform digitally, and U5B sums it with the filtered DC offset and a +5 V term to drive CH1.

blocks.name: ch2-amplitude-and-offset
blocks.purpose: Same digital amplitude and offset summing stage for channel 2, using U13 and U12.

blocks.name: offset-dac
blocks.purpose: The MCP4822 dual 12-bit DAC sets the DC offset of each channel.

blocks.name: output-relays
blocks.purpose: GPIO-driven NPN relay drivers with flyback diodes connect each channel to its output terminal through a 49.9 Ω source resistor.

parts.J3: Barrel jack for the 12 V DC input; pin 2 is ground and pin 1 goes to the power switch.
parts.SW2: Wire-connected on/off switch between the barrel jack and the +12C rail that feeds U2 and U3.
parts.C1: 0.22 µF input capacitor on +12C for the LM7805 and the TMR DC-DC converter.
parts.U2: TMR 6-1222 DC-DC converter that makes +12 V and -12 V from +12C for the op-amps; its REMOTE pin is left unconnected.
parts.U3: LM7805 linear regulator that makes +5 V from +12C for the relays, the DevKit 5V pin, the 3.3 V LDO and the offset reference.
parts.U16: AP2112K-3.3 600 mA LDO, with EN tied to VIN so it is always on, that makes the +3.3 V rail from +5 V.
parts.C2: 100 nF high-frequency decoupling on the +5 V rail.
parts.C32: 1 µF capacitor on +5 V that serves as the LM7805 output cap and the AP2112 input cap.
parts.C33: 1 µF capacitor on +3.3 V that serves as the AP2112 output cap.
parts.R31: 0 Ω link that ties the DevKit's two 3V3 pins to the board +3.3 V rail, so U16 and the DevKit's onboard regulator share one rail unless R31 is left unfitted.
parts.U1: ESP32-S3 DevKitC that controls everything: SPI bus to the DDS and DAC chips, display/touch SPI, encoder inputs, attenuator switch control and relay drive.
parts.R7: 10k pull-up on U8 ~SYNC (GPIO9) so the CH1 AD5452 stays deselected while the MCU boots.
parts.R23: 10k pull-up on U13 ~SYNC (GPIO40) so the CH2 AD5452 stays deselected while the MCU boots.
parts.R24: 10k pull-up on U17 ~CS (GPIO14) so the MCP4822 stays deselected while the MCU boots.
parts.DS1: ILI9341 TFT display module with touch controller: display and touch share SCK (GPIO4) and MOSI (GPIO5), and touch data returns on GPIO6.
parts.SW1: Rotary encoder module (A on GPIO1, B on GPIO2, push switch on GPIO42) for user input.
parts.U6: AD9833 DDS module that generates the CH1 waveform; it is selected by FSYNC on GPIO10.
parts.U7: AD9833 DDS module that generates the CH2 waveform; it is selected by FSYNC on GPIO39.
parts.SW3: TS5A23157 dual SPDT analog switch (IN1 on GPIO21, IN2 on GPIO47) that routes each DDS output either straight to func_in (NC) or through the 39.2k attenuator (NO).
parts.R3: 39.2k series arm of the CH1 attenuator, giving about 0.203× when SW3 selects NO1.
parts.R4: 10k shunt arm of the CH1 attenuator, which also loads func_in to ground in the direct path.
parts.R16: 39.2k series arm of the CH2 attenuator (≈0.203×).
parts.R17: 10k shunt arm of the CH2 attenuator and ground reference for CH2 func_in.
parts.U15: OPA2810 used as a unity-gain buffer (U15A) for the 0.423 V CENTER_BIAS reference that both channels use.
parts.R25: 68.1k top resistor of the divider from +3.3 V that sets CENTER_BIAS to about 0.423 V.
parts.R26: 10k bottom resistor of the CENTER_BIAS divider.
parts.C15: 1 µF filter capacitor on the CENTER_BIAS divider tap, at the U15A input.
parts.U4: OPA2810: U4A gives ≈5.0× gain on func_in while subtracting ≈4.0×CENTER_BIAS, and U4B adds 4× gain to produce gained_func for the AD5452 VREF.
parts.R5: 499 Ω gain-setting resistor from CENTER_BIAS to U4A IN-; with R6 it sets gain 1+2k/499 and the offset subtraction.
parts.R9: 1k ground leg of the U4B gain network.
parts.R10: 3k feedback resistor of U4B, giving gain 1+3k/1k = 4.
parts.U11: OPA2810 doing the same two-stage offset-removal and gain function for CH2.
parts.R18: 499 Ω gain/offset resistor from CENTER_BIAS to U11A IN-.
parts.R21: 1k ground leg of the U11B gain network.
parts.U8: AD5452 12-bit multiplying DAC (~SYNC on GPIO9) that scales the CH1 gained_func applied at VREF, giving digital amplitude control.
parts.U13: AD5452 12-bit multiplying DAC (~SYNC on GPIO40) that does the same amplitude control for CH2.
parts.U5: OPA2810: U5A is the I-to-V converter for U8 IOUT using the internal RFB, and U5B is a summing stage that drives CH1.
parts.U12: OPA2810: U12A is the I-to-V converter for U13, and U12B is the summing output stage that drives CH2.
parts.C21: 1.5 pF compensation capacitor across U5A (RFB to IOUT) that stabilises the multiplying-DAC I-to-V stage.
parts.C22: 1.5 pF compensation capacitor across U12A for the CH2 multiplying-DAC stage.
parts.R29: 4.02k summing resistor that brings the scaled CH1 waveform from U5A into U5B IN-.
parts.R12: 4.02k summing resistor from +5 V into U5B IN-, which contributes a fixed -5 V term at CH1.
parts.R13: 4.02k feedback resistor of U5B; with equal resistors, CH1 = 3·dc_offset − 5 V − V(U5A-OUT).
parts.R30: 4.02k summing resistor from U12A into U12B IN-.
parts.R14: 4.02k summing resistor from +5 V into U12B IN- (fixed -5 V term for CH2).
parts.R20: 4.02k feedback resistor of U12B, which sets the CH2 summing gains.
parts.U17: MCP4822 dual 12-bit voltage DAC (~CS on GPIO14, ~LDAC grounded) whose VA and VB outputs set the CH1 and CH2 DC offsets.
parts.R11: 1k resistor that, with C20, forms an RC low-pass (~1.6 kHz) on DAC_A before U5B IN+.
parts.C20: 100 nF filter capacitor on the CH1 dc_offset node.
parts.R15: 1k resistor that, with C24, low-pass filters DAC_B before U12B IN+.
parts.C24: 100 nF filter capacitor on the CH2 dc_offset node.
parts.SW4: Omron G5V-1 SPDT relay that connects CH1 (COM) to the output path (B contact) when energised.
parts.SW5: Omron G5V-1 SPDT relay that connects CH2 to its output path when energised.
parts.Q1: 2N3904 low-side switch for the SW4 relay coil, driven from GPIO41.
parts.Q2: 2N3904 low-side switch for the SW5 relay coil, driven from GPIO13.
parts.R8: 1k base resistor for Q1 from GPIO41.
parts.R27: 47k base pull-down that keeps Q1 (and the CH1 relay) off while GPIO41 floats at boot.
parts.R28: 1k base resistor for Q2 from GPIO13.
parts.R32: 47k base pull-down that keeps Q2 (and the CH2 relay) off at boot.
parts.D1: 1N4148 flyback diode across the SW4 relay coil that protects Q1.
parts.D2: 1N4148 flyback diode across the SW5 relay coil that protects Q2.
parts.R1: 49.9 Ω series source resistor (2512 size) that sets the CH1 output impedance to about 50 Ω.
parts.R2: 49.9 Ω series source resistor that sets the CH2 output impedance to about 50 Ω.
parts.J1: CH1 output terminal block (signal and ground).
parts.J2: CH2 output terminal block (signal and ground).
parts.J4: 2-pin socket in parallel with J1, giving a second CH1 output connection.
parts.J5: 2-pin socket in parallel with J2, giving a second CH2 output connection.

nets.+12C: Switched 12 V from the barrel jack through SW2, feeding both the ±12 V DC-DC converter and the 7805.
nets.+12V: Positive analog rail from U2 that supplies all OPA2810 V+ pins.
nets.-12V: Negative analog rail from U2 for the OPA2810 V- pins; it is decoupled by C4/C6/C10/C12/C14/C34/C35/C36 even though the tool lists it as a signal net.
nets.+5V: 7805 output that feeds the relay coils, the DevKit 5V pin, the AP2112 input, and the +5 V term in the offset summers.
nets.+3.3V: AP2112 output that powers the DDS modules, DACs, analog switch, display, encoder and CENTER_BIAS divider.
nets.Net-(R31-Pad1): The DevKit 3V3 pins, which reach the board +3.3 V rail only through the 0 Ω link R31.
nets.GPIO11: Shared SPI MOSI to both AD9833s, both AD5452s and the MCP4822.
nets.GPIO12: Shared SPI clock to both AD9833s, both AD5452s and the MCP4822.
nets.GPIO10: FSYNC chip select for the CH1 AD9833 (U6).
nets.GPIO39: FSYNC chip select for the CH2 AD9833 (U7).
nets.GPIO9: ~SYNC chip select for the CH1 AD5452 (U8), pulled up by R7.
nets.GPIO40: ~SYNC chip select for the CH2 AD5452 (U13), pulled up by R23.
nets.GPIO14: ~CS for the MCP4822 offset DAC, pulled up by R24; with ~LDAC grounded, the outputs update when CS rises.
nets.GPIO4: SPI clock shared by the ILI9341 display and its touch controller.
nets.GPIO5: SPI MOSI shared by the ILI9341 display and its touch controller.
nets.GPIO6: Touch-controller data out (T_DOUT) back to the MCU; the display's own MISO is unused.
nets.GPIO21: Selects whether CH1 goes direct or through the attenuator (SW3 IN1).
nets.GPIO47: Selects whether CH2 goes direct or through the attenuator (SW3 IN2).
nets.GPIO41: Enables the CH1 output relay through Q1.
nets.GPIO13: Enables the CH2 output relay through Q2.
nets.Net-(SW3A-COM1): Raw CH1 AD9833 output into the analog switch common.
nets.Net-(SW3B-COM2): Raw CH2 AD9833 output into the analog switch common.
nets.CENTER_BIAS: Buffered 0.423 V reference that U4A and U11A subtract (×≈4) so the amplified DDS waveform is roughly centred on 0 V.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/func_in: CH1 DDS signal (direct or attenuated) at the non-inverting input of the U4A gain stage.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/func_in: CH2 DDS signal (direct or attenuated) at the non-inverting input of U11A.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/gained_func: CH1 waveform amplified about 20×, applied as the reference voltage of the U8 multiplying DAC.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/gained_func: CH2 waveform amplified about 20×, applied as VREF of U13.
nets.Net-(U5A-IN-): AD5452 IOUT summing node held at virtual ground by U5A.
nets.Net-(U5A-OUT): U5A output, equal to −VREF·code/4096, closed through the AD5452 internal RFB and fed to the summer via R29.
nets.Net-(U12A-OUT): CH2 scaled waveform from the U13/U12A I-to-V stage, fed to the summer via R30.
nets.DAC_A: MCP4822 channel A output that sets the CH1 DC offset.
nets.DAC_B: MCP4822 channel B output that sets the CH2 DC offset.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/dc_offset: RC-filtered offset voltage at U5B IN+, which appears at CH1 with ×3 gain.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/dc_offset: RC-filtered offset voltage at U12B IN+, which appears at CH2 with ×3 gain.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/5V_ref: U5B inverting summing node that combines +5 V, the scaled waveform and the CH1 feedback through equal 4.02k resistors.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/5V_ref: U12B inverting summing node for CH2.
nets.CH1: Final CH1 signal (waveform plus offset) from U5B to the SW4 relay common.
nets.CH2: Final CH2 signal from U12B to the SW5 relay common.
nets.Net-(D1-A): Low side of the SW4 relay coil, switched by Q1 and clamped by D1.
nets.Net-(D2-A): Low side of the SW5 relay coil, switched by Q2 and clamped by D2.
nets.Net-(J1-In): CH1 output after the relay and the 49.9 Ω source resistor, brought out to J1 and J4.
nets.Net-(J2-In): CH2 output after the relay and the 49.9 Ω source resistor, brought out to J2 and J5.
